olivia: quick sync 1: need to pick defaults for prefetch window ownership across SDKs (py/ts/go). server-owned, client-owned, or opt-in?

mike: current issue: server and some SDKs both prefetch -> duplicate upstream work and weird throttling.

sara: my bias: server-owned by default for hosted. central control, easier metrics and global throttles. SDKs should opt-out.

raj: caution: private/dedicated installs will prefer client defaults. server default could silently change behavior for on-prem customers.

olivia: proposal: keep one SDK surface but have `mode: \"auto\"` resolve based on deployment metadata: hosted -> server, private/dedicated -> client.

casey: API sketch (shared shape):
```
client = RedwoodClient({
  prefetch: { mode: "auto", window_tokens: 128 }
})
```
auto uses server when it sees host metadata.

mike: two open questions: (1) who implements backoff/retry for prefetch, (2) how to avoid double-prefetch with old SDKs?

sara: (1) the component that issues the prefetch should own backoff. if server prefetches, server rate-limits. SDKs must support cancel/resume idempotently. (2) server advertises capability header `x-rw-prefetch: handled=v1` so SDKs skip local prefetch when present. lightweight versioned handshake.

raj: transport: prefer unary header handshake by default. offer an optional control stream for long-lived sessions where server can push `prefetch_adjust` messages. streaming helps low-latency workloads.

casey: session API example: `session = client.open_session({prefetchStream: true})` -> listens for window adjustments. keep this opt-in to reduce SDK complexity.

mike: billing: speculative prefetch might waste tokens. we should bill only tokens that the model actually consumed; add telemetry `prefetch_speculative=true` for attribution. default conservative window 128.

sara: agreed; telemetry fields: `prefetch_mode`, `prefetch_speculative`, `server_prefetch_version`. we'll document how to interpret them.

raj: long-term note: unify prefetch and kv-cache into a single client-side cache/policy module so strategies swap cleanly. add to Q3 roadmap.

olivia: decision summary: hosted -> server-owned default; private/dedicated -> client default; SDKs expose `prefetch.mode` with `auto|server|client|off`; server uses header `x-rw-prefetch`; unary header by default + optional Session control stream; default window_tokens=128; telemetry + e2e tests for old-sdk fallbacks.

casey: i'll draft a short RFC with API examples, header names, handshake flow, and migration notes.

mike: i'll add e2e tests (old SDK + new server) and a small load test for speculative waste.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created issue INFR-2377: "prefetch ownership defaults + sdk handshake" assigned to @casey.

olivia: thanks. tagging followups: @sara telemetry, @raj session proto, @mike e2e. closing thread for now. :rocket:
